description: Source code for a custom RichEditBox control (MathRichEditBox) used in a calculator app, handling math input, formatting, and submission events.

classes.name: MathRichEditBox
classes.description: Custom RichEditBox control for math input with formatting, event handling, and math mode management.

classes.name: MathRichEditBoxSubmission
classes.description: Represents a submission event for the MathRichEditBox, indicating if text changed and the source of submission.

classes.name: MathRichEditBoxFormatRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates a request to format the math text, including original and formatted versions.

methods.name: MathRichEditBox
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control, setting math mode, and registering event handlers.

methods.name: OnMathTextPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the MathText property, updating the math text accordingly.

methods.name: InsertText
methods.description: Inserts text at the cursor position, creating a math zone if necessary.

methods.name: SubmitEquation
methods.description: Submits the current math equation, requesting final formatting and raising events.

methods.name: BackSpace
methods.description: Handles backspace key behavior within the math input.

methods.name: OnKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides key down behavior to suppress bold shortcut.

methods.name: GetMathTextProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the current math text from the document.

methods.name: SetMathTextProperty
methods.description: Sets the math text in the document.

methods.name: OnLosingFocus
methods.description: Handles focus loss, submitting the equation if appropriate.

methods.name: OnKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events, submitting on Enter key.
